mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, A.FSUBJECT_NO AS fsubjectId, A.BAL_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, A.O_CCY AS oCcy, A.O_AMT AS balance, A.O_C_AMT AS cAmt, A.O_D_AMT AS dAmt, A.NUM_AMT AS num, A.IS_LEAF AS isLeaf, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, A.BALANCE_DATE balanceDate, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel, A.BAL_CO_FLAG balCoFlag, A.O_CO_AMT oCcyKnotsAmt, A.O_CO_C_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtC, A.O_CO_D_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtD, A.B_CCY bCcy, A.B_AMT bAmt, A.B_C_AMT bCAmt, A.B_CO_AMT bCoAmt, A.B_CO_C_AMT bCoCAmt, A.B_CO_D_AMT bCoDAmt, A.B_D_AMT bDAmt, 0 tdyOAmt, 0 tdyOCAmt, 0 tdyODAmt, 0 tdyOCoAmt, 0 tdyOCoCAmt, 0 tdyOCoDAmt, 0 tdyBAmt, 0 tdyBCAmt, 0 tdyBDAmt, 0 tdyBCoAmt, 0 tdyBCoCAmt, 0 tdyBCoDAmt, A.TDY_AMT_FLAG tdyAmtFlag, A.TDY_CO_FLAG tdyCoFlag, 0 tdyPurODUlamt, 0 tdyRedODUlamt, 0 tdyPurOCUlamt, 0 tdyRedOCUlamt, 0 tdyPurBDUlamt, 0 tdyRedBDUlamt, 0 tdyPurBCUlamt, 0 tdyRedBCUlamt, CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '99' THEN D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ELSE C.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE END as baseSubjectNature FROM BOK_BALANCE A /** 科目余额 **/ LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb /** 账套 **/ ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C /** 账套科目 C **/ ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = A.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT D /** 账套科目 D **/ ON D.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND D.SUBJECT_NO = A.FSUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BALANCE_DATE = #{queryDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

select a.Bookset_Id booksetId, /** 账套代码 **/ A.BOOK_DATE bookDate, /** 入账日期 **/ NVL(A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, A.SUBJECT_NO) AS subjectNo, /** 科目号 **/ A.CD_FLAG balFlagHappenDate, /** 借贷方向 AS 余额方向 **/ A.o_Ccy oCcy, /** 原币 AS 币种 **/ A.O_HAPPEN_AMT balance, /**原币发生额 AS 科目余额 **/ A.HAPPEN_NUMBER num, (CASE WHEN a.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN A.SUBJECT_NO ELSE BBB.FSUBJECT_ID END) AS fsubjectId, /* 上级科目号*/ (CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN #{bottomLevel} ELSE BBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL END) AS subjectLevel, /** 科目级别 **/ 0 AS dAmt, /** 借方余额 **/ 0 AS cAmt, /** 贷方余额 **/ NULL AS isleaf, /** 是否叶子节点 **/ A.TABLE_ID tableId, /** 场景代码 **/ A.b_ccy bCcy, /** 本位币 **/ A.B_HAPPEN_AMT bAmt /** 本币科目余额 **/
from bok_bookdetail_all A /** 账务明细（历史表） **/ LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb /** 账套 **/ on bb.bookset_id = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bbb /** 科目信息表 **/ ON bbb.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bbb.SUBJECT_NO = a.SUBJECT_NO where A.Bookset_Id = #{booksetId} and A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} and A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} ORDER BY A.BOOKSET_ID,A.HAPPEN_DATE,A.BUSI_ID,A.TRADE_ID
